executive_summary: AltifyAI (venture-1, live site/auth/usage/PBN scoring) has 19 chairman-approved stage transitions on record but ZERO rows in eva_stage_gate_attempts (SD-LEO-INFRA-MINUS-EVIDENCE-LAYER-001's transition-evidence ledger, merged PR #7440) -- every chairman-adjudicated advance bypasses the ledger entirely, because the chairman-approval code path (_handleChairmanGate -> _advanceStage in lib/eva/stage-execution-worker.js) never calls the existing, generic, already-tested recordGateAttempt() wrapper that 4 other machine-gate call sites already use. LEAD-phase verification (Explore evidence 2a677465, VALIDATION evidence 0443c8b7) measurement-falsified this SD's original FR-1/FR-2 (launch_mode/launched_at reconciliation and retroactive guardrail seeding) as either a universal-default misattribution or gated behind a structurally-unreachable Stage-24 check for AltifyAI specifically -- both descoped. This PRD covers the confirmed, actionable remainder: wire AltifyAI's (and every other daemon-walked venture's) future chairman-adjudicated stage advances through the existing recordGateAttempt() mechanism, with the one hard technical constraint that the call must fire exactly once per genuine transition and never once per poll tick -- the same code shape that produced a live 1034-row runaway-retry backlog on a different venture (ApexNiche AI) when a gate-check branch was polled repeatedly while a downstream chokepoint stayed blocked.

functional_requirements.title: Record a chairman-adjudicated attempt row on every real _advanceStage() transition
functional_requirements.description: In lib/eva/stage-execution-worker.js's _advanceStage() (the daemon-walk's single side-effecting stage-advance function, ~line 2825), after the raw ventures.current_lifecycle_stage UPDATE succeeds and all of _advanceStage()'s own chokepoints (artifact precondition ~2962, high-consequence ~3027, product-review ~2935, path-integrity ~3193) have passed, call the existing recordGateAttempt(supabase, opts) wrapper (lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js:486-532) with {ventureId, stageNumber: <the FROM stage>, gateType: 'stage_gate' (maps to 'exit' via recordGateAttempt()'s GATE_TYPE_MAP), resolvedOutcome: 'chairman_adjudicated', passed: null, reasoning: <chairman_decisions row reference/summary>, evaluatedBy: 'chairman'}. resolvedOutcome='chairman_adjudicated' is an existing, already-reserved value in eva_stage_gate_attempts' CHECK constraint (database/chairman-gated/20260823_eva_stage_gate_attempts.sql:63) distinct from 'machine_pass'/'machine_fail'/'override' -- passed must be left NULL for this outcome (the table's own CHECK at line 115 requires passed IS NULL for any resolved_outcome other than machine_pass/machine_fail). This is a pure additive call to existing, tested infrastructure -- no new RPC, no schema change, no re-implementation of open_eva_gate_attempt/finalize_eva_gate_attempt. CORRECTION (TESTING, e7445772): the original gateType:'chairman_gate' is INVALID -- GATE_TYPE_MAP has no entry for it and it violates the table's CHECK(gate_type IN ('entry','exit','kill')). Use 'stage_gate' (maps to 'exit'). The new call must ALSO be wrapped in the same non-fatal try/catch pattern used at the 4 existing recordGateAttempt() call sites (lib/eva/eva-orchestrator.js:930,1316; stage-17-blueprint-review.js:471; artifact-persistence-service.js:636) -- a ledger-write failure must never block the real stage advance it is merely recording. CRITICAL: this call must fire ONLY when FR-1a's source tag confirms a genuine chairman decision (see FR-1a) -- NOT on every _gateApproved=true, which is also set by 3 other non-chairman auto-approval paths.
acceptance_criteria: CORRECTED (VALIDATION c39db537): these criteria originally described end-to-end fixture behavior (a real DB row appearing after a real _advanceStage() invocation). _advanceStage() was independently assessed as too large/entangled to unit-test end-to-end (7+ .from() calls, 4 dynamic imports) -- the actual, negotiated coverage is source-inspection (tests/unit/eva/advance-stage-chairman-attempt-recording.test.js): the recordGateAttempt() call is placed immediately after the raw ventures UPDATE, gated on the exact chairmanGateSource==='chairman_decision' string, uses gateType='stage_gate' and resolvedOutcome='chairman_adjudicated', and is wrapped in a non-fatal try/catch -- each verified by static assertion against the real source text, not a live DB row.

_handleChairmanGate()'s source-tagging (FR-1a) IS behaviorally tested end-to-end in isolation (tests/unit/eva/stage-execution-worker-chairman-gate-source.test.js constructs a real StageExecutionWorker and exercises all 5 branches) -- this is the layer where genuine behavioral proof is feasible; the _advanceStage() integration layer relies on source-inspection instead.

functional_requirements.title: _handleChairmanGate() must tag its return value with the actual decision source
functional_requirements.description: _handleChairmanGate() (lib/eva/stage-execution-worker.js:2357) has 5 distinct return points that all currently produce the identical {blocked:false,killed:false,approved:true} shape: (1) autonomy auto-approve (~line 2381), (2) governance auto-approve via _canAutoAdvance (~line 2388), (3) fixture-venture skip (~line 2460), (4) an already-resolved chairman_decisions row found on re-entry (~line 2473), (5) a freshly-resolved decision via waitForDecision (~line 2502). Only (4) and (5) represent a genuine chairman decision; (1)-(3) are automated bypasses. Add a `source` field to every returned object (e.g. 'autonomy_auto_approve' | 'governance_auto_approve' | 'fixture_venture_skip' | 'chairman_decision') so FR-1's new recordGateAttempt() call site can distinguish them. Without this, FR-1 as originally scoped would mislabel every autonomy/governance/fixture auto-approval fleet-wide (not just AltifyAI) as chairman_adjudicated -- a MORE dishonest instrumentation defect than the one this SD exists to fix. CORRECTION (TESTING re-review, 56dc6248): adding a source field is confirmed non-breaking for the one real production consumer (stage-execution-worker.js:1401, which only reads .blocked/.killed), but BREAKS two existing unit tests that pin the exact return shape via toEqual (rejects unexpected extra keys): tests/unit/eva/stage-execution-worker-high-consequence-mint.test.js:268 and tests/unit/eva/stage-execution-worker-fixture-venture-gate.test.js:98. Both must be updated (add the new source key to each expected object) in the SAME commit that implements this FR -- not a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 5 return points in _handleChairmanGate() carries a distinct, correct `source` value, verified by a unit test exercising all 5 branches independently.
FR-1's new recordGateAttempt() call fires ONLY when source==='chairman_decision' -- a fixture exercising the other 4 sources produces ZERO new eva_stage_gate_attempts rows.

tests/unit/eva/stage-execution-worker-high-consequence-mint.test.js:268 and tests/unit/eva/stage-execution-worker-fixture-venture-gate.test.js:98 are updated to expect the new source key and still pass.

functional_requirements.title: The new call site must not reproduce the retry-amplification failure mode already observed in production
functional_requirements.description: _handleChairmanGate() (lib/eva/stage-execution-worker.js:2357-2517) returns {approved:true} on EVERY poll tick once a chairman_decisions row is status='approved' (line 2471), not just the first time -- the daemon's main walk loop (~line 1401) re-invokes this on every poll interval for a venture still parked at an unresolved stage. If _advanceStage() itself then blocks on one of its own independent chokepoints (a real, observed condition), a naively-placed recordGateAttempt() call inside the approval-detection branch (rather than gated on the UPDATE's actual success) would fire once per poll tick indefinitely. This is not hypothetical: eva_stage_gate_attempts currently holds 1034 rows for a single OTHER venture (ApexNiche AI), attempt_number climbing past 518, new rows every ~30s since 2026-07-31, with open_eva_gate_attempt having zero idempotency/dedup by design (SELECT MAX(attempt_number)+1 then unconditional INSERT). FR-1's call site MUST be placed strictly after the successful UPDATE, gated on the transition actually having occurred in THIS invocation (not on the approval/gate-check branches, which can re-fire every poll cycle while downstream stays blocked).
acceptance_criteria: CORRECTED (VALIDATION c39db537): same test-strategy correction as FR-1 -- 'a fixture venture polled N times' describes end-to-end behavior not actually exercised. What IS verified: the recordGateAttempt() call site sits strictly AFTER _advanceStage()'s raw ventures UPDATE (source-position assertion, tests/unit/eva/advance-stage-chairman-attempt-recording.test.js), so a venture that never reaches that UPDATE (still blocked at an earlier chokepoint) structurally cannot reach the new call -- proven by code position, not by simulating N poll ticks.

4 additional call sites VALIDATION found (pre_exec_skip_trigger, pre_exec_skip, re_entry) that re-confirm an already-approved chairman_decisions row WITHOUT calling _handleChairmanGate() in that tick are also gated via an explicit chairmanGateSource:'chairman_decision' context flag, verified present at exactly 4 call sites by source inspection -- closing the gap where AltifyAI's real approvals reaching these paths would otherwise still produce zero eva_stage_gate_attempts rows. CORRECTED AGAIN (VALIDATION 04f7f256, 2nd re-review round): the first fix's own inventory (pre_exec_skip_trigger, pre_exec_skip at the gate-specific guard, re_entry) missed a 4th, structurally distinct call site -- a SEPARATE 'pre_exec_skip' advancementType living in the P0 UNIVERSAL pre-execution guard block (covers taste-gate/promotion-gate/other non-BLOCKING stages), which independently re-confirms an approved chairman_decisions row via its own query. All 4 are now tagged; the test asserts 4 total occurrences of the flag plus 2 occurrences of the specific pre_exec_skip-tagged literal (since 2 of the 4 sites share that advancementType string).

functional_requirements.title: Fixture and regression coverage proving the wiring, not just its absence of a false trigger
functional_requirements.description: Add unit tests exercising the real _advanceStage() code path (or the smallest real function boundary that reaches recordGateAttempt(), per this repo's existing pattern in tests/unit/eva/artifact-persistence-service-gate-attempt.test.js which mocks supabase.rpc and asserts open/finalize call shape) proving both FR-1's positive case and FR-2's negative/regression case. Mirror the call-count regression-guard pattern already used in tests/unit/eva/orchestrator-gate-result-persist.test.js (grep source for a fixed recordGateAttempt() call count at the new call site) so a future edit that removes or duplicates the call is caught mechanically, not just by code review. CORRECTION (TESTING, e7445772): _advanceStage() is too large/entangled (7+ .from() table calls, 4 dynamic imports) to unit-test directly by mocking supabase.rpc alone. Split coverage into (a) an ISOLATED unit test on _handleChairmanGate()'s new source-tagging return shape (FR-1a's acceptance criteria) -- small, mockable, real function boundary -- and (b) TS-3's call-count regression guard as the integration-level check that the new recordGateAttempt() call site exists inside _advanceStage() and is gated on the source tag. Do NOT attempt a full behavioral unit test of _advanceStage() itself.
acceptance_criteria: TS-1/TS-2 below (positive: one call on success; negative: zero calls across repeated polls while blocked) both pass against the REAL _advanceStage() function, not a reimplementation of its logic.
A call-count regression guard (grep-based or call-count assertion) exists for the new recordGateAttempt() call site, mirroring orchestrator-gate-result-persist.test.js's existing pattern.

technical_requirements.title: Reuse recordGateAttempt() verbatim -- no new RPC or schema
technical_requirements.description: The new call site must use the existing lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js:486 recordGateAttempt(supabase, opts) wrapper unmodified. Do not call supabase.rpc('open_eva_gate_attempt'/'finalize_eva_gate_attempt') directly from stage-execution-worker.js -- that would create a second, divergent call shape for the same underlying mechanism, the exact vocabulary-drift class this SD's sibling SDs (signal-lane, receipt-ledger) have repeatedly had to correct this session. CORRECTION: gateType must be 'stage_gate' (maps to 'exit'), never 'chairman_gate' (unmapped, violates the DB CHECK constraint).

technical_requirements.title: Post-condition gating, not pre-condition/detection-branch gating
technical_requirements.description: The call must be placed strictly after _advanceStage()'s raw UPDATE has succeeded and all of its own chokepoints have passed for THIS invocation -- never inside _handleChairmanGate()'s approval-detection branch (which is idempotently re-true on every poll once approved, independent of whether the actual advance has happened yet).

technical_requirements.title: stageNumber records the FROM stage of the transition
technical_requirements.description: gate_type/stage_number semantics must match the existing 4 call sites' convention (verify against lib/eva/eva-orchestrator.js:930/1316 and stage-17-blueprint-review.js:471 at EXEC time) so a future cross-venture query over eva_stage_gate_attempts treats chairman-adjudicated rows consistently with machine-evaluated ones.

technical_requirements.title: Non-fatal try/catch around the new recordGateAttempt() call, matching existing call sites
technical_requirements.description: The new call inside _advanceStage() must be wrapped in a try/catch that logs and continues on failure, never blocking or reverting the real stage advance it records -- matching the pattern at all 4 existing recordGateAttempt() call sites.

technical_requirements.title: _handleChairmanGate()'s decision-source tag is the single source of truth for 'is this a genuine chairman decision'
technical_requirements.description: No other heuristic (e.g. re-deriving from chairman_decisions table state independently in _advanceStage()) should be used to decide whether to call recordGateAttempt() -- avoids a second, potentially-diverging classification of the same event.

No new RPC, no schema migration, no re-implementation of open_eva_gate_attempt/finalize_eva_gate_attempt.
The retry-amplification failure mode already observed in production (ApexNiche AI, 1034 rows) is explicitly regression-tested against, not merely avoided by inspection.

risks.risk: Placing the new call in the wrong location within _advanceStage() (e.g. before all chokepoints resolve, or inside a branch that can re-fire on repeated polls) reproduces the exact runaway-retry pattern already observed in production on a different venture.
risks.mitigation: TR-2 + TS-2 explicitly test the negative case (repeated polling while blocked produces zero rows) as the PRIMARY regression test, not an afterthought.

risks.risk: FR-1/FR-2 from the SD's original (coordinator-authored) scope -- launch_mode/launched_at reconciliation and retroactive guardrail seeding -- remain genuinely unaddressed; a future reader might assume this PRD's FR-1/FR-2/FR-3 numbering means the original SD's FR-1/FR-2 were delivered when they were explicitly descoped at LEAD.
risks.mitigation: This PRD's executive_summary and the SD's own metadata.plan_content addendum + metadata.mechanism_verifications explicitly document the descope and its reasons; a future SD re-attempting AltifyAI's launch_mode/guardrail honesty should read those first.

risks.risk: TESTING's live-recheck found the migration comment '@approved-by: PENDING' and a code comment claiming recordGateAttempt() always fails with PGRST202 are themselves STALE -- a live RPC probe confirmed the function is callable (FK violation, not PGRST202) and the table holds 1182 live rows. A future reader trusting those comments without re-verifying would incorrectly believe this SD's dependency is unmet.
risks.mitigation: This PRD records the live-verified contradiction; EXEC should also correct or remove the stale comments while touching this code, as a small drive-by fix.

risks.risk: VALIDATION (PLAN_VERIFICATION, evidence c39db537) found the FIRST implementation only instrumented the _handleChairmanGate() -> _advanceStage() pathway, missing 3 OTHER call sites (pre_exec_skip_trigger, pre_exec_skip, re_entry) that advance off an already-approved chairman decision without ever calling _handleChairmanGate() in that tick -- these are documented, recurring production shortcuts (worker re-entry after approval, DB-trigger-already-applied side effects), not edge cases. A SECOND VALIDATION re-review round (evidence 04f7f256) found the first fix had itself missed a 4th call site (a separate pre_exec_skip site in the P0 UNIVERSAL guard, distinct from the gate-specific one already fixed) -- underscoring that an exhaustive call-site trace, not a sample, is required whenever instrumenting a shared multi-call-site function.
risks.mitigation: Fixed in the same PLAN_VERIFICATION cycle: an explicit chairmanGateSource context flag threaded through all 3 call sites, source-inspection-tested with a mutation-verified primary regression test. Second fix applied in the same PLAN_VERIFICATION cycle, re-verified by both VALIDATION and REGRESSION.

consumers: Any future dashboard/audit query over eva_stage_gate_attempts that expects chairman-adjudicated advances to be represented alongside machine-evaluated ones.

The venture-lifecycle stage-advancement daemon walk (lib/eva/stage-execution-worker.js) itself -- the new call is additive instrumentation inside its existing advance path, not a new consumer-facing surface.
dependencies: eva_stage_gate_attempts table + open_eva_gate_attempt/finalize_eva_gate_attempt RPCs (SD-LEO-INFRA-MINUS-EVIDENCE-LAYER-001, PR #7440) -- already live, no dependency work needed.
recordGateAttempt() wrapper (lib/eva/artifact-persistence-service.js) -- already live and tested, reused verbatim.
data_contracts: eva_stage_gate_attempts.resolved_outcome='chairman_adjudicated' -- an existing, already-reserved CHECK-constraint value, not a new one.
observability_rollout: Post-deploy smoke test (TS-4 / this SD's top-level smoke_test_steps): confirm the next real chairman-approved AltifyAI stage transition produces a matching attempt row.

Monitor eva_stage_gate_attempts row-growth rate for the daemon-walked venture population after rollout, given the explicit runaway-retry risk this SD is designed to avoid (not just for AltifyAI, but for every venture that flows through the now-instrumented _advanceStage() path).
